entities.summary: Jozef Turanec was a Slovak general during World War II. During his military career, he served as a soldier in the Austro-Hungarian Army during World War I, later as an officer in the Czechoslovak Army and eventually reaching the post of a 2nd Class General in service of Slovakia.
